title: Bijectivity of bounded monomial reconstruction in a triangular quotient
statement: Let k be a field, d,m natural numbers, h in R=k[X_0,...,X_{d-1}], and p_i a monic polynomial over k[X_0,...,X_{d+i}] of natural degree e_i. Let Q be the simultaneous quotient by hT-1 and the triangular p_i, and D=Localization.Away h. Suppose psi:D→ₐ[k]Q agrees on R with the canonical renamed quotient map. Then the k-linear map from bounded-exponent-indexed D-valued functions to Q sending c to the sum of psi(c(a)) times the quotient monomials product_i [Y_i]^(a_i) is bijective. This includes zero h, zero degrees, and empty towers, and does not involve an evaluation into a field.

source.place: Proof of Tag 07BV, first assertion, triangular minimal polynomials and denominator clearing; Tag 08JZ, localization presentation. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07BV and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08JZ because the local literature checkout is absent.

proof.text: Express the displayed linear map pointwise as the sum of coefficient images times bounded monomials. For injectivity subtract two coefficient functions and apply uniqueness of zero expansions; linearity gives that their difference maps to zero. For surjectivity apply bounded-monomial spanning to the requested class.

proof_origin.note: Separate existence and uniqueness in the original monic division argument, then combine by linearity.

theorem triangularFieldModel_reconstruction_bijective
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (d m : ℕ) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k)
    (p : (i : Fin m) → Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + i.val)) k))
    (e : Fin m → ℕ) (hp : ∀ i, (p i).Monic)
    (he : ∀ i, (p i).natDegree = e i)
    (psi : Localization.Away h →ₐ[k]
      (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + m)) k ⧸
        Ideal.ofList (triangularFieldModelEquations k d m h p)))
    (hpsi : ∀ r : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k,
      psi (algebraMap _ (Localization.Away h) r) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _
        (MvPolynomial.rename (fun j : Fin d ↦
          (⟨j.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1 + m))) r)) :
    Function.Bijective
      (∑ a : ((i : Fin m) → Fin (e i)),
        (LinearMap.mulRight k (∏ i : Fin m,
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X
            (⟨d + 1 + i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin (d + 1 + m)))) ^ (a i).val)).comp
            (psi.toLinearMap.comp (LinearMap.proj a)) :
        ((((i : Fin m) → Fin (e i)) → Localization.Away h) →ₗ[k]
          (MvPolynomial (Fin (d + 1 + m)) k ⧸
            Ideal.ofList (triangularFieldModelEquations k d m h p))))
